# Project Quality

**A client-side Fabric modpack focused on stunning visuals and stylish gameplay.**

![3D](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c778f2dca866d84f8c03030f972215ec25567ffc.png)

---

### ✅ You Get:

- ✨ **Looks first. RTX-style with shaders & 64x textures**


- 🧩 **Client-side glow-up. Smooth, clean, better visuals**


- ⚠️ **Not for potatoes. Prioritizes beauty over FPS**


- 🎮 **Vanilla-ready. Works on any server**

---

### 💡 Why Project Quality?

Built for those who want Minecraft to look as good as it feels. I created this pack to deliver a fresh, modern vibe with vibrant lighting, atmospheric effects, and polished visuals without going full HD or breaking your system. It’s all about balance: clean, cinematic gameplay while keeping things light and modular.
